activated_rules.rule_name: Consignor may be verified if the legal entity appears anywhere in the invoice
Summation of multiple lines within the same invoice

consignor.certificate_value: Derome Timber AB behalf of | Eagle Timber Oy Ltd | Mikonkatu 22B23 | VAT: FI16497381 | 00100 Helsinki | Finland
consignor.invoice_value: Invoice Address EAGLE TIMBER OY LTD Mikonkatu 22 B 23 00100 HELSINKI FINLAND; Tax Identity FI16497381
consignor.motivation: The certificate consignor block contains the explicit legal entity 'Eagle Timber Oy Ltd' with Finnish address and VAT FI16497381. The invoice contains the same entity in the invoice address block with the same country and VAT identity. 'Derome Timber AB behalf of' was not used as the matched legal entity; the positive match is based on the explicit occurrence of 'EAGLE TIMBER OY LTD' in the invoice.

consignee.certificate_value: Mounzer Hazem Sammakieh EST | 31 Al Islam Street, Al Hamra, Jedda | Contact name: Mounzer Sammakieh | Contact number: +966565562780 | mounzersammakieh@gmail.com | VAT: 312959310700003 | CR/LICENSE: 7049800498 | Saudi Arabia
consignee.invoice_value: Invoice Address EAGLE TIMBER OY LTD, Mikonkatu 22 B 23, 00100 HELSINKI, FINLAND; Delivery Address Kinnared Stuffning (ej moms), Marknadsvägen, 314 05 Kinnared, SWEDEN
consignee.motivation: All relevant recipient roles in the invoice were checked. The invoice shows 'EAGLE TIMBER OY LTD' in Finland and 'Kinnared Stuffning' in Sweden, but nowhere shows 'Mounzer Hazem Sammakieh EST' or Saudi Arabia as consignee, ship-to, buyer, sold-to, bill-to or delivery party. The invoice therefore positively fails the consignee verification.

goods_description.invoice_value: Whitewood Sawn board VI+ 25x100 3,0 m; Whitewood Sawn board VI+ 25x100 3,3 m; Whitewood Sawn board VI+ 25x100 3,6 m; Whitewood Sawn board VI+ 25x100 3,9 m; Whitewood Sawn board VI+ 25x100 4,5 m
goods_description.motivation: The certificate description 'Whitewood' is explicitly identifiable in the invoice goods lines as the leading identity-bearing term 'Whitewood Sawn board'. The additional invoice text ('Sawn board', dimensions and lengths) is supplementary detail and does not prevent verification of the certificate's stated goods description.

quantity.motivation: The certificate gives an explicit quantity '282,262m3'. The invoice splits the same Whitewood goods across five lines with volumes 57.8025, 28.38, 92.223, 16.77 and 87.08625 nm3; the sum is 282.26175, which matches the certificate quantity within the allowed tolerance.

origin.motivation: The invoice explicitly states 'Country of origin: Sweden' on page 2. This directly verifies the certificate origin 'SWEDEN' after case normalization.

critical_failures: Consignee mismatch: the certificate names 'Mounzer Hazem Sammakieh EST' in Saudi Arabia, while the invoice recipient information shows 'EAGLE TIMBER OY LTD' in Finland and delivery address 'Kinnared Stuffning' in Sweden.
overall_assessment.decision_summary: The document pair is not identical because the certificate consignee cannot be identified in any invoice recipient field. Consignor, goods description, quantity and origin can be verified, but one applicable control point is a clear mismatch.
overall_assessment.human_explanation: Mottagaren i certifikatet är 'Mounzer Hazem Sammakieh EST' i Saudiarabien. Fakturan visar i stället 'EAGLE TIMBER OY LTD' i Finland och leveransadress 'Kinnared Stuffning' i Sverige, och den certifierade mottagaren kan inte identifieras i något mottagarfält. Övriga kontrollpunkter kan verifieras, men dokumentparet är därför inte identiskt.
